_note: 2_S05 'Cook's Crush' — stage 1 of the two-half Edna script (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_S05-cooks-crush-cooks-date.md): fetch perfume from the staff room, a candy box from Fatty downtown, and a sedative bottle from the trash cans, then hand it all to Edna. STAGE-VARIANT DECISION: the original is one script whose launcher calls F_SetStage(1|2) before main() (multi_stage_mission_param, launcher-owned, OPEN there); our port is **two mission JSONs sharing the trigger file** — 2_S05.json (Cook's Crush) and 2_S05B.json (Cook's Date) — with two campaign rows (2_S05 / 2_S05B), because our mission ids are file stems and the catalog lists the halves separately. v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the baked 2-S05/2-S05B cutscenes are title-card + speech beats; the staff-room teachers' fire-alarm evacuation (global_fire_alarm_hook) is skipped — the lounge is empty and the door is open; the 30 s linger-punishment and bump-punishment beats are skipped (punishment points pending); the bribe-or-beat Fatty branch takes the bribe (a social purchase — the mug/violence branch is documented); the trash cans are three stationary target dummies at the real can positions and the bottle is in a FIXED can (can 2 — the randomized_loot_prop one-of-N pick is pending, so no dice here); the hobo wakes after the cans are smashed (the original wakes him on the first wrong can); his bottle-break/puke gags are skipped; Edna's chapter-2 dressed variant (model 221) is noted but both our instances use the usual stand-in; the ambient Edna swap (shared.gEdnaID) is skipped. No SMissPass case (VERIFIED absence); no persistent reward in-script either. Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: Cook's Crush

lines.speaker: EDNA
lines.text: Jimmy! There's a certain chemistry teacher... I need perfume, candy, and a little something to calm my nerves. Fetch them and I'll make it worth your while.

stages.objective: Lift the perfume from the staff room.

on_start.speaker: JIMMY
on_start.text: Staff room's clear. In and out.

stages.objective: Get the candy box from Fatty, downtown.

on_complete.speaker: FATTY
on_complete.text: My LAST box. You're lucky I'm between cravings.

stages.objective: Smash the trash cans for the sedative bottle.

on_complete.speaker: JIMMY
on_complete.text: One little bottle. Edna had better appreciate this.

stages.objective: The hobo guarding the cans is NOT happy.
Bring the ingredients back to Edna.

on_complete.speaker: EDNA
on_complete.text: Perfect! Tonight, Jimmy Hopkins, Edna cooks for Dr. Watts. Come watch the magic — Cook's Date is the campaign's 2_S05B row.
no SMissPass case (VERIFIED absence); the two-half script is split into 2_S05/2_S05B mission files (see _note for the stage-variant decision)
